sam-soc: Heads up: vendor "RedProbe" booked a blackbox test week of Jun 9. Need to lock down RBAC, KMS access pattern, and evidence handoff. cc @lea-sec

lea-sec: I can draft the minimal role: `pt_assessor_readonly` with CloudWatch/S3 readonly and explicit deny on iam:PassRole and deploy APIs. Add TTL tag for auto-revoke.

omar-eng: KMS rule: no plaintext key material to external parties. We'll provision an envelope key plus a decrypt-proxy that logs calls to CloudTrail. If they ask for kms:Decrypt, deny.

tess-ops: For logs: export control-plane/cloudtrail + app logs to a locked bucket in ops account with object lock. Retention: 180d standard, copy with 1y retention for assessment. We'll enable SHA256 integrity manifests.

audit-bot: Pre-eng questionnaire received:  https://forms.example.com/s/abc123. Requested targets: https only, one service account, no DB creds.

sam-soc: Retest flow: label tickets `pt/needs-retest`, criteria = repro steps + logs + deployment id + security signoff. @tess-ops can you own the evidence bucket and presigned link policy?

tess-ops: Yes. Presigned uploads OK (48h TTL), server-side encryption with customer-managed CMK, object-lock governance enabled. I'll post bucket name and access checklist by EOD Thu.

lea-sec: I'll open infra-roles PR and include assume-role example and automated lambda revocation snippet. Brief QA + security review before apply to staging.

omar-eng: I'll add KMS audit export snippet to runbook and ensure key-id is present in logs. Also add decrypt-proxy metrics for suspicious activity.

sam-soc: Scheduling a 20m tabletop next Tue to walk rollback/IR and evidence access. If no objections, proceed with owners above. :white_check_mark:
